name: dropzone_skydive
provenance: Hand-written layout fixture for the DropZone skydiving brief (tests/fixtures/README.md). Tests Steps 4-7 only — it says nothing about what the schema-fill LLM produces.
notes: VerticalCorridor + exit platform: locomotion=fly, altitude-banded content, a Cessna the player exits, a landing pad on the ground. Explicit objective kinds (collectible/goal) and no tags, the mirror image of dropzone_arcade's tag-carried meaning.
